intro.text: The authoritative record of changes made after publication. The register is split in two — one side tracks changes to the operational systems participants integrate with, the other tracks corrections to published documentation.

blocks.text: Release Notes describe what was deployed to the platform. Erratas describe what was corrected in the published documentation. Use them together to understand where the ecosystem stands.
Both registers are bound by the policies that control how published content evolves and how versions are promoted.
